intended_object: An explicit bijection, used inside proofs, between the even k-colourings of an edge subset of a fragment V (the subset lifted from t with the `true` choice at a closed cut) and the even k-colourings of the subset t of the fragment obtained by gluing the boundary pair i, j shut. Inferred from the docstring, the name and its uses in ColourGlue.lean.
explanation: This is a transport `Equiv` for the library's own proofs, not a standard mathematical object. It says that colourings agree across a closing cut. It is built by sending each surviving flag to its underlying flag and back, and both inverse laws hold by `rfl`. It exists only to rewrite sums over even colourings in the skein/gluing arguments; its only uses are as `.symm` around lines 1581 and 1919–1947 of the same file. The bijection itself is a lemma-level fact. The literature has no named object for it to be measured against, and Mathlib has nothing comparable.
